title: Create AI Partner
visibilityPublicHint: Visible to everyone on Discover and searchable. Anyone can view your AI profile and chat with it.
visibilityPrivateHint: Only you can see this AI and chat with it. Hidden from Discover and the Marketplace.
visibilityMarketplaceHint: Listed on the Marketplace. Anyone can view the profile, but chatting requires paying you in Souls.
priceSoulsHint: Set how many Souls users must pay to chat with this AI. Buyers view the profile for free.
basePromptPlaceholder: System prompt for the AI character
exampleDialoguesPlaceholder: Example conversations to guide the character
imagesHint: These images will show on the partner's Images tab.
nameRequiredMessage: Please give your AI a name.
nameReserved: This name is reserved. Please choose a different name.
sharedCardHint: This AI uses a shared character card. The name below becomes this AI's name — the card itself is not copied or changed.
personaOwnedHint: This character card belongs to one of your personas, so it can't be used by an AI partner. This state can appear from data synced before that rule existed.
aliasConflictMessage: Another AI partner already uses this name. Please choose a different name.
